create_UVGDataModule: create a UVGDataModule instance to load the UVG evaluation dataset with configurable frame count and normalization
test_UVGDataModule_dataloader: test the UVGDataModule by calling test_dataloader to get a PyTorch DataLoader for evaluation
build_UVGDataModule_custom_collate: build a custom collate function that transforms batched image tensors into a VideoDataset format
review_UVGDataModule_transforms: review the UVGDataModule _transforms method that converts images to tensors with optional normalization
run_UVGDataModule_evaluation: run the UVG evaluation dataset datamodule with 13 videos of 300 frames each at 1080p resolution
